statement: Test whether EURUSD research anchors with a large M15 body-to-range ratio and sufficiently large M15 range have positive 4-hour directional trading value on the LONG side.
rationale: The packet ranks x.m15.body_to_range as the dominant LightGBM gain feature and x.m15.range_fraction as the second strongest. The LONG direction and numeric thresholds are unverified Discovery hypotheses and are not claimed as established facts.
